scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof using elliptic-quotient isogeny and explicit elimination, with standalone exact symbolic reproduction; independent mathematical validation not performed.

title: Complete characteristic-seven \(p\)-rank and \(a\)-number strata of a genus-three Howe family
